method: Scale the preserved 125-task pilot ledgers to the current two-condition scope, using the verified 2026-09-07 pricing schedule. Natural includes all production roles and evaluator measurement; mixed includes its new Gate/Critic/Optimizer path, evaluator measurement, and recorded unknown-usage reservations. Historical pilot charges are excluded.

mixed_condition.note: The mixed pilot had 43 attempts with unknown usage. Reservations are retained for the budget ledger and are not asserted as billed cost.

limitations: This is not a provider invoice or guaranteed upper bound.
It extrapolates preserved pilot usage; actual output lengths, retries, failures, and evaluator usage may differ.
The mixed condition reuses upstream natural artifacts, as specified; reused upstream costs are not charged again.
The 5000-attempt limit and USD49.99 cap remain hard stopping rules. Unknown usage is never treated as zero.
